title: Dated regulation and asset-comparison guides added

summary: Added event search, event-type and impact filters, recovery-state filtering, multiple sort modes, result counts, stablecoin labels in the event table, and event-count visibility on stablecoin detail pages.

title: Event layer expanded from 3 to 23 records

Added launch, protocol transition, regulatory, recovery, reserve-intervention, chain-halt, chain-expansion, and exchange-support context while deferring weak or insufficiently dated candidates.
